name: editor_state
description: Read current document, scenes, selection, clip, camera, warnings, physics and optionally all node transforms. Read after commands to verify their effects.

name: scene
description: Manage document tabs and files. new templates: empty/mannequin/demo. open appends/reuses an empty tab. save writes a self-contained project and marks it clean. export writes baked FBX/GLB/glTF without a dialog. close refuses dirty documents unless discard=true. Returns current state.

name: editor_preferences
description: Query, preview-independent apply, or reset portable editor preferences. Validated settings exclude MCP credentials, recent files and private paths. Returns actual language/font/action state. Shortcuts use stable action IDs.

name: scene_visuals
description: Query or edit authored scene visuals with the same validation and Undo as the Scene dock. settings is a partial nested patch. Read capabilities for supported features, authored and applied state. Does not invalidate motion analysis or physics.

name: node_select
description: Select one or multiple bones/controllers; mode replace/add/toggle. node=-1 or empty nodes clears selection. editor_state returns primary selected and full selection.

name: pose_transform
description: Set TRS while preserving omitted components. space controls position; rotationSpace controls rotation (default local); scale is local. Key writes into the current recording target. Pins/limits remain active.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

frame.description: Optional frame to evaluate before editing.

key.description: Write a full pose key after the edit. Defaults to true for pose/morph operations.

symmetric.description: Mirror the edited bone/IK chain to its assigned partner in the same Undo operation.

rotationSpace.description: Euler rotation coordinate space, independent of position space; defaults to local for compatibility.

name: pose_ik
description: Move an end effector with the editor two-bone IK/reach solver. World-space target and pole; unreachable goals clamp to reach. pin=true retains a world pin. Returns achieved position and residual.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

frame.description: Optional frame to evaluate before editing.

key.description: Write a full pose key after the edit. Defaults to true for pose/morph operations.

symmetric.description: Mirror the edited bone/IK chain to its assigned partner in the same Undo operation.

name: pose_pin
description: Set/remove a world-space pin, pin both named feet, or clear all pins. Omitted target/pole use current positions. Weight 0..1.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

frame.description: Optional frame to evaluate before editing.

key.description: Write a full pose key after the edit. Defaults to true for pose/morph operations.

name: pose_operation
description: Apply rest pose, mirror, named-humanoid crouch, or toggle reach assistance. All operations support Undo.

frame.description: Optional frame to evaluate before editing.

key.description: Write a full pose key after the edit. Defaults to true for pose/morph operations.

node.description: Source bone for copy_opposite; the source stays unchanged, its opposite IK chain or FK bone is copied.

name: pose_limits
description: Set/remove a cone rotation limit relative to rest, in degrees. Applies the limit immediately and solves pins.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

frame.description: Optional frame to evaluate before editing.

key.description: Write a full pose key after the edit. Defaults to true for pose/morph operations.

name: morph_set
description: Set a morph target weight on a mesh node. Weight is a multiplier (1 = 100 percent), matching inspector range -100..100. Creates a key by default.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

frame.description: Optional frame to evaluate before editing.

key.description: Write a full pose key after the edit. Defaults to true for pose/morph operations.

name: timeline
description: Seek, set clip range/FPS, play/pause/loop, insert/delete/move/copy keys, copy/paste a pose, jump to previous/next key, or fit timeline. frame selects destination/current time; from selects source key. Existing-key replacement requires replace=true for paste only.

node.description: Bone index/name; select_track accepts -1 for the explicit whole-layer/whole-pose summary.

channels.description: Component mask: Position=1, Rotation=2, Scale=4. Explicit channel insertion does not expand an IK chain.

includeChain.description: For node-scoped insertion: include IK root/mid/end. Defaults to false with an explicit channel mask, true otherwise.

whole.description: Explicit whole-bundle insertion, bypasses selected-bone defaults.

name: history
description: Undo or redo completed edits. Stops playback first.

name: view
description: Control camera, viewport tools and display overlays. camera rotations are degrees, distance/center are scene units. preset: perspective/front/side/top/fit. Returns camera and node projections.

name: contact
description: List/add/remove/clear planted foot contact intervals. Add rejects overlapping intervals for a node. Positions and pole are world-space.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

name: physics_settings
description: Set any world physics settings. Omitted properties are preserved. Changes invalidate preview and support Undo.

name: physics_body
description: Fit a capsule rig or edit a single body mass/radius/COM/tip. center and end are local scene-unit coordinates. list returns fitted bodies if no explicit rig exists.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.
Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

name: physics_preview
description: Native MuJoCo background calculation: simulate (legacy external-anchor preview), flight (ballistic COM + conserved angular momentum) or optimize (bounded control shooting with real geom contacts and independent forward replay). Poll status/report, cancel, apply to a separate document; UUID/revision stale protection.

prepareLanding.description: Prepare intermediate leg reference poses around authored landing; defaults true. Model, initial state, contact schedule and important poses stay fixed.

name: scene_bake
description: Bake corrections or an experimental parabolic COM arc to a separate scene, optionally save it. Source stays in its own tab.

name: batch
description: Atomically apply up to 256 pose/key/contact/physics edits to a staging copy, then commit one Undo entry. On failure scene and history remain unchanged. timeline supports seek/range/insert/delete/move/copy in a batch; contact supports add/remove/clear; physics_body fit/set. Unsupported operations reject the batch.

name: screenshot
description: Capture the real editor window or viewport including gizmos/overlays. Returns a PNG image content block and optional saved path.

name: record_frames
description: Render a deterministic PNG sequence from the current animation, with one clip-frame per step. Restores playhead/playback afterwards. At most 600 images per call; use the returned FPS for encoding. No wall-clock playback drift.

name: editor_actions
description: List menu/toolbar actions with stable IDs, labels, shortcuts and enabled/checked state. Includes scene, layout, help and MCP controls.

name: editor_action
description: Trigger an existing QAction by ID or exact objectName. Executes on the Qt event loop after returning so modal dialogs remain controllable through ui tools. Disabled actions return errors.

name: ui_inspect
description: Inspect live Qt controls and modal dialogs. IDs remain valid while widgets exist. objectName can also be used when unambiguous. visibleOnly defaults true; include hidden controls to discover collapsed panels.

name: ui_set
description: Set an existing spinbox, slider, checkbox, line edit or combo box. Spinboxes commit editingFinished; this uses the same handlers as the UI. Values outside widget ranges are rejected.

name: ui_click
description: Click a button or accept/reject a Qt dialog; queued to keep modal interactions responsive. operation defaults click. ui_inspect exposes controls and buttons in every dialog.

name: ui_select
description: Select a tree/list item by row path (e.g. [0,2,1]), combo/tab by index, or switch/close a scene tab through scene. Tree/list paths are zero-based and match ui_inspect items.

name: ui_key
description: Send a key sequence to a Qt control, e.g. Ctrl+C, Delete, Escape, Return. Window shortcuts are resolved through enabled editor actions. Use typed tools for workflows that do not need UI gestures.

name: ui_pointer
description: Send real viewport/timeline mouse gestures. Coordinates are logical widget pixels; view returns projected joint coordinates. begin/update/end allow intermediate screenshots; drag performs one complete gesture with Undo.

name: motion_correction
description: Create and edit ordered keyed additive correction layers, compare original, or bake an independent result.

channels.description: Component mask: Position=1, Rotation=2, Scale=4. Explicit channel insertion does not expand an IK chain.

includeChain.description: For node-scoped insertion: include IK root/mid/end. Defaults to false with an explicit channel mask, true otherwise.

whole.description: Explicit whole-bundle insertion, bypasses selected-bone defaults.

name: character_profile
description: Assign saved humanoid roles, explicit root/mid/end IK chains, rest-space pole directions and reciprocal mirror pairs. suggest applies unambiguous name suggestions.

name: whole_body
description: Solve multiple weighted/prioritized hard/soft effectors plus a COM projection goal, preserving bone lengths and directed limits. Current pins/contacts are kinematic goals only. Writes one key in the selected layer, one Undo; returns actual residuals and solved/infeasible status. Positions use scene units. COM projection is not dynamic validation.

node.description: Node index from editor_state, or exact unique node name. Indices are scoped to the active scene.

name: physics_analyze
description: Compile the native model, measure SI mass/COM/inertia/linear and angular momentum, diagnose unsupported rigid transforms, or export readable MJCF. No mutable engine pointer is returned. Explicit proxy_preview measures scale and world geometry; proxy_create opens a separate approximate rigid scene. Private source assets remain unchanged.

name: motion_annotations
description: Edit context metadata with Undo, search/filter, stable bundle-key attachments, explicit affine retime or trim. Retime/trim affect context only; outside trimmed annotations are retained and marked. Key moves carry attachments; deletion retains orphaned context; ordinary FPS changes preserve seconds.

name: motion_context
description: Read-only authored notes and nearest events. Exact times remain seconds; display/navigation use nearest frame, ties toward +infinity. Interval frame bins are half-open; points and sub-frame intervals occupy their nearest frame. Compact notes include description (256 chars), textTruncated/textLength, nodeNames, startFrame/endFrame and point. detail full returns full text; motion_annotations list with id retrieves any complete note. Text is not a constraint.

id.description: Filter context to a specific annotation ID; use detail full for its entire text.

name: animation_curves
description: Author local scalar position/scale/morph and explicit unwrapped YXZ Euler curves, or SO(3) quaternion Step/SLERP/spherical cubic channels. Outgoing segment owns mode; angular tangents are local rad/s. Atomic set/remove with Undo. Layers and IK are evaluated afterwards.

name: motion_trajectory
description: Read-only evaluator snapshot sampling. Paginated bounded CPU work; derivative of moving-frame coordinates; explicit discontinuity status. Does not replay physics from arbitrary time.

name: retarget_profile
description: Review role mapping / calculate bounded humanoid transfer / create independent result document. Calibrated FK plus optional two-bone IK; target proportions retained. Reports approximate reach and explicit contact-planning limitations.

name: retarget_preview
description: Review role mapping / calculate bounded humanoid transfer / create independent result document. Calibrated FK plus optional two-bone IK; target proportions retained. Reports approximate reach and explicit contact-planning limitations.

name: retarget_apply
description: Review role mapping / calculate bounded humanoid transfer / create independent result document. Calibrated FK plus optional two-bone IK; target proportions retained. Reports approximate reach and explicit contact-planning limitations.

name: analysis_job
description: Start snapshot trajectory/compare analysis on a worker thread; poll/cancel and page revision-bound immutable results. Finish pending edits first. One retained job per editor.

name: motion_compare
description: Bounded read-only mapped transform comparison. Time, duration-normalized phase or explicit event alignment; optional root/height normalization. Original timings preserved; sampled geometry, not a physics certificate.

name: motion_validate
description: Sampled proxies, directed authored joint limits, structured expectations, skinned mesh-pair or self triangle BVH intersections, and closed-volume containment. Welded adjacency is excluded from self checks; only the first hit per mesh is reported. Approximate/confirmed/uncertain/allowed remain distinct; no dynamic certificate.

adaptive.description: Bounded midpoint refinement near rapid travel, curvature and joint-origin proximity; no continuous certificate.
